messages:
elaine: quick heads-up: i've sketched a follow-up to the autoscaler RFC that publishes fractional 'headroom tokens' + per-sku normalization instead of raw gpu counts. goal is better packing for many short requests and clearer cost signal for routing. posting proto draft in the RFC link.

mike: curious: main win is packing efficiency or separating cost vs capacity?

elaine: both. tokens let prewarm be consumable units so short jobs don't waste whole slots. cost_usd_hr travels with the snapshot so routing can pick cheaper pools. proto snippet in RFC.

raj: operational worry: eviction relies on discrete slots and tenant priority. fractional tokens could affect ordering. we need a clear "hard SLA" shield.

elaine: agreed. tokens are advisory for admission and soft-eviction scoring only. hard eviction will still consult reserved_slots and active_lease metadata. scorer sample: eviction_score = base_priority + preempt_penalty - gamma * capped_token_balance + delta * recent_cost_spike. cap the token influence.

sophia: add seq id + ttl on snapshots and a token_staleness metric. if stale, scorer ignores tokens. also include a debug expanded snapshot on /debug.

carol: ops/UI ask: show mapping like "0.05 token ~= one short chat request" and per-sku factors in UI. publish a minute-sampled set of expanded debug rows to help SRE.

mike: billing note: single authoritative cost_source. billing and routing read same cost_usd_hr field.

autoscaler-bot: queued canary: headroom-token-rollout on canary-3 at 2026-03-23T15:00Z. collect token_staleness, eviction_churn, p95_tail.

elaine: rollout checklist i'll include in RFC: proto w/seq+ttl, sku_factors table, capped soft-scorer, telemetry + dashboards, canary matrix, rollback threshold (eviction_churn > 3x or p95 > 1.2x baseline). tagging @mike @sophia @raj @carol.

mike: :thumbsup: keep hard SLA shield and conservative canary.

elaine: will open RFC follow-up with diffs, scorer pseudocode, dashboards, and test plan. DM me for urgent issues.

autoscaler-bot: canary metrics posted: first 10m window: token_staleness_med=0.9s, eviction_churn=1/10m, p95_tail +2.5% vs baseline. dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/headroom-token-canary

elaine: nice. closing thread, will ping when RFC is ready for final review.
